description: This file defines a Java interface for module configuration data access operations within the sales manager core system. It extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for retrieving module configurations based on module name or code.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDao
classes.description: Interface for accessing module configuration data, extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module configurations based on the provided module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single module configuration identified by its module code.
